title: 反詐投資王 — Anti-Gambling Trader
resourceType: Local-first trading statistics, investment-fraud defense and automated-trading development toolkit
purpose: 用交易紀錄與統計證據區分可重複 edge 與運氣／倖存者偏差，同時檢查詐騙話術、假績效與老師宣稱；亦可產生可回測與 paper-first 的自動交易專案。
recommendation: 適合學習『先證明策略，再允許自動化』的交易系統設計：expectancy、顯著性檢定、bootstrap、樣本外驗證與風控 gate 應位於 live execution 之前；敏感交易資料預設留在本機。
notes: README states trade analysis remains local. Statistical validation includes expectancy, t-test plus centered bootstrap and out-of-sample validation. Generated automation uses PaperBroker by default; historical runner does not place live orders. User-built live execution requires broker keys, a live runner and explicit unlock while preserving safety checks.
